name: Northanger Abbey
source:
Northanger Abbey: The Game! Experience Jane Austen's classic satirical romance in a whole new way. Dance, love, and discover the secrets of the Abbey. Choose one of three genders and five love/friendship interests, and see what lies beyond the pages of the novel.

[Edited from [url=https://spiralatlas.itch.io/northanger-abbey-the-game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《諾桑覺寺：遊戲》！以全新方式體驗珍．奧斯汀的經典諷刺愛情故事。跳舞、戀愛，發現修道院的秘密。選擇3種性別之一，以及五位可以談戀愛或交朋友的對象，看看小說之外還有什麼。

[據[url=https://spiralatlas.itch.io/northanger-abbey-the-game]itch.io[/url]編輯]
